result.eventDescription: Charged when a Maps listing is an accepted match. low_confidence, no_match, blocked, and error rows are saved and not billed.

proxy.eventDescription: Charged when a Maps query is retried through Apify Proxy after a direct search is blocked. Direct searches are free. A robots disallow is not retried.

captcha.eventDescription: Charged only when a solver returns a token after the proxy retry is still a challenge. A disabled or unconfigured solve is not billed.
